mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, busness_type, file_size, file_name, file_type, oss_sp, bucket, file_id, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM mdm_file_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{timeFrom} AND create_time <= #{timeTo} AND id = #{id} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND busness_type = #{busnessType} AND file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileName}, '%') AND file_type = #{fileType} AND oss_sp = #{ossSp} AND bucket = #{bucket} AND file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, tenant_code, busness_type, file_size, file_name, file_type, oss_sp, bucket, file_id FROM mdm_file_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT id, tenant_code, busness_type, file_size, file_name, file_type, oss_sp, bucket, file_id FROM mdm_file_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND file_id IN ( #{item} )
